stories.headline: Cutter Tampa lands roughly 13 tonnes of cocaine and 1.5 tonnes of marijuana at Port Everglades from six Pacific interdictions
stories.summary: The Coast Guard cutter unloaded about 29,600 pounds of cocaine and 3,355 pounds of marijuana in Florida on October 14, with a stated value near $226.7 million.
